reference_first_response.summary: Two genuinely opposed observations of the same target exist: Lab A's independently reviewed 28-minute median (supports) and Lab B's independent 34-minute median (refutes), same city, same year, same metric and population. The opposition itself is established by these supported observations without needing to decide which lab is right; the packet states the discrepancy is unresolved, so the claim cannot be adjudicated as simply true or false.
gaps: The 28-vs-34 minute discrepancy across two independent citywide 2023 samples has not been resolved, and the packet gives no sample sizes or precision estimates, so it is unknown whether a statistically significant difference exists between the two lab estimates; this unresolved opposition blocks a definitive verdict.
contradictions: Lab A reports a 2023 citywide Westport median of 28 minutes (below 30); Lab B reports 34 minutes (above 30) on the same metric, population and year, and the packet says the discrepancy has not been resolved.
next_queries: Obtain both labs' sample sizes, sampling methods and confidence intervals to determine whether the 28-vs-34 minute difference is statistically significant or reconcilable.

assessment.summary: The causation claim rests solely on the vendor's self-interested press release, which admits its before/after comparison was not adjusted for traffic volume, construction, seasonality or other changes. S2 merely repeats the vendor's figures without independent verification. No independent, confounder-adjusted measurement supports or refutes the causal 15 percent reduction.

evidence.finding: S1 P1 is the vendor's own press release (2024-06-01) claiming its new Southport signal system caused a 15 percent reduction in junction delays versus 2023, and states the comparison did not adjust for traffic volume, construction, seasonality or other changes.

quotes.https://s1.authored.example/record: Vendor press release, 2024-06-01: Our new Southport signal system caused a 15 percent reduction in junction delays compared with 2023. We compared observed delays before and after installation but did not adjust for traffic volume, construction, seasonality or other changes.

evidence.finding: S2 P1 (Southport Bulletin, 2024-06-02) repeats the vendor press release's 15 percent causation claim and acknowledges it collected and verified no measurements, so it is a derivative repetition, not independent confirmation.

quotes.https://s2.authored.example/record: Southport Bulletin, 2024-06-02: According to the vendor press release, the signal system caused a 15 percent reduction in delays versus 2023. This article repeats the vendor's figures and did not collect or independently verify any measurements.
